CoachingAnalytics.mealSource: Source: meals clients marked done, grouped by their recorded day. Zero means no logs.
CoachingAnalytics.workoutSource: Source: workout-plan and home-schedule logs. Kept separate because the same exercise can appear in both.
CoachingAnalytics.adherenceSource: Source: averages of submitted and reviewed check-ins by week month. Missing values stay blank.
CoachingAnalytics.walkingSource: Last 30 days per client, using each client timezone and historical targets. Steps and kilometres are never combined.
CoachingAnalytics.walkingTotalsSource: Source: sum of client daily totals versus assigned targets. Target totals include clients without a log; missing logs stay blank.
CoachingAnalytics.walkingOutcomesSource: One result per client-day. Excludes today, rest days, paused days and days without an assigned target.
CoachingAnalytics.sessionsHint: Coaching delivery over the current month and previous 11 months. Future sessions are excluded.
CoachingAnalytics.attendanceSource: Source: coach-recorded attended and missed sessions, grouped by session date.
CoachingAnalytics.sessionStatusSource: Source: attendance status of sessions dated within the reporting period. Scheduled means not yet marked.
CoachingAnalytics.consultationsSource: Source: consultation status in the reporting period. {count} have a recorded service conversion.
